q2_gaps: century-denoting time expressions ("in the 16th century") — the Time term inventory stops at Year, and no rule licenses converting a century into year bounds (the parse improvised TimeAtLeast (Year 1501) / TimeAtMost (Year 1600), inventing two numbers the text never states and silently picking the 1501-1600 convention)

nationality/origin modifiers in a fused compound kind — such adjectives are licensed to FUSE (breton_tapestry) but the modifier-exposure list names only gradable, positional/cardinal and material adjectives, so whether (Inheritance algerian_city algerian) must be emitted is underdetermined (the predication test says yes, the enumeration says nothing)

"many" as a count on an episodic object NP — it is listed as a proportion word (strength 0.7) whose strength has no home in a specific past clause, while the CardinalityPhrase vague-quantity list does not include it
notes: Group + fused compound kind + genus, Agent for the inanimate transitive subject Spain, Theme for a seized-but-unchanged object, and the Name atom are all as specified; the century bounds are true under the standard convention but are an unlicensed improvisation rather than a defect in meaning.
